Models

Utilities

scale_bart() unscale()
Scaling responses to and from the BART scale
rMVN()
Sampling once from a multivariate normal distribution with mean mu and precision Q
rMVNc()
Sampling from a multivariate normal distribution with precision Q and mean equal to the solution of Q mu = b
multi_rMVN()
Sampling multiple times from a multivariate normal distribution
matrnorm()
Sampling from a matrix normal distribution MV(mu, U, V)
